articleTitle: Integrated home gateway controller for home energy management system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A low cost and highly reliable home gateway controller with plug & play mechanism for a home energy management system (HEMS) is developed. The HEMS utilizing the home gateway controller is also developed and is installed in 20 houses in the Tokyo area.

articleTitle: Perceptual cryptography of JPEG compressed images on the JFIF bit-stream domain
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Whereas conventional cryptography is suitable for any kind of data, it does not allow for perceptual degradation of encrypted data in multimedia-compressed formats. We present the notion of perceptual cryptography applied to JPEG compressed images. We propose a backward compatible format-compliant JPEG/JFIF encryption scheme that allows for the graceful degradation via encryption of compressed images with both configurable zone of encryption and quality loss. Applications include encrypted image sampling and purchase by consumers using existing JPEG renderers via broadcasting, peer-to-peer network seeding or Web-based publishing. Existing image encryption schemes (Dang, P.P. and Chau, P.M, 2000; Lintian Qiao and Nahrstedt, K., 1998; Jui-Cheng Yen and Jiun-In Guo, 1999, 2000; Scharinger, J., 1998) do not address configurable graceful degradation and backward compatibility on the bit-stream domain at the same time.

articleTitle: Smart Baton System: a universal remote control system in ubiquitous computing environment
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper describes a universal remote control system - Smart Baton System. This system enables users to explicitly and easily choose an appliance with a laser pointer, and provides users with an appropriate user interface that is customized for each appliance. Furthermore, with user authentication, this system allows an appliance to provide differentiated service to each user.

articleTitle: Tackling occlusion in scan rate conversion systems
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We present a motion compensated frame rate up-conversion algorithm which aims at reducing the interpolation artefacts in occlusion areas. This algorithm uses motion vectors estimated between two successive frames, and uses the same 2 frames for the up-conversion.

articleTitle: Real-time face detection with MPEG-4 codec LSI for a mobile multimedia terminal
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose an intelligent easy-operating human-machine interface incorporating face detection technology for a mobile multimedia terminal. We have developed a face detection algorithm which works on the resources of a mobile phone. This algorithm is robust in outside fields, and simultaneously works with MPEG-4 Simple Profile Level 1 encoding and decoding on an MPEG-4 codec LSI for a mobile videophone. This enables more intelligent interfaces in visual communication such as IMT-2000 videophone services.

articleTitle: /spl copy/ watermark: closing the analog hole
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper is about copy protection and watermarking. It presents a way to close the analog hole through a new concept, called the /spl copy/ watermark. The dawn of the digital world has also boosted the piracy of digital content. Current responses are suitable as long as the content remains digital. Unfortunately, the weakest link in the delivery chain is the analog video or audio link. Pirates, as dishonest users, can play the content, record these analog signals, digitise them, and distribute the files. We call this threat the analog hole. The /spl copy/ watermark offers a more robust method to close analog hole piracy. It has a simpler trust model than current solutions. Compared with current watermarked-based approaches, this new concept offers better resistance to malicious attacks.

articleTitle: Using multi-frequency modulation in a modem for the transmission of near-realtime video in an underwater environment
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The system described in this paper uses multicarrier modulation, and has been successfully tested at a data rate up to 10 kbps over 1 km. The system algorithm generates 48 frequencies for transmitting 48 parallel bits of data in each packet. A long transmitted signal sequence is combined with synchronisation, zero gap and information packets. The long multi-frequency signal packets have been implemented to minimise the effect of multipath fading, which is a particular problem in shallow, open water environments. To acquire the starting point of the transmitting sequence, a linear frequency modulation (LFM) signal is used for synchronisation. In order to reduce noise, adaptive threshold packets are used to set up a suitable signal. Experimental results from sea-trials have shown that the system can cope with multipath fading environments.

articleTitle: A content-based browsing system for a HDD and/or recordable-DVD personal video recorder
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The personal video recorder such as recordable-DVD recorder and/or hard disk recorder has become popular as a large volume storage device for video/audio content and a browsing function that would quickly provide a desired scene to the user is required as an essential part of such a large capacity system. We propose an intra-program content browsing system using not only a combination of motion based video summarization and topic-related metadata in the incoming video stream but also an audio-assisted video browsing feature that enables completely automatic topic-based browsing.

articleTitle: A study of seamless communication method with the adequate switching between optical and RF wireless LAN
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a method that can continue communication even when it is switched over between optical and RF wireless LAN.

articleTitle: Quality of service mapping and related issues for bridging 1394 and Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents the major issues involved in developing a home audio-video network that accommodates both IEEE 1394 and IEEE 802.3 Ethernet devices. The two technologies differ on handling audio-video (AV) data streams, and a number of issues arise when transferring AV streams between the two technologies. Notably, 1394 and IP Ethernet have differing implementations for quality of service (QoS) protocols. In order to aid in the conversion between the two technologies, a QoS draft standard currently under consideration in the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA) is discussed in detail.

articleTitle: A generalized Braat-Hopkins model for optical recording channels
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a generalized Braat-Hopkins model for read-only and re-writable optical channels. The objective is to expose the effect of code rate and recording density on the various parameters of the channel model, so that this model can be used to assess the receiver performance for various code rates and recording densities.

articleTitle: ROI video coding based on H.263+ with robust skin-color detection technique
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper proposes an ROI (region of interest) video coding algorithm based on H.263+. The ROIs are automatically selected by a robust skin-color detection which utilizes the Cr and RGB variance instead of the traditional skin color models, such as YCbCr, HSI, etc. The skin color model defined by Cr and RGB variance can choose the skin color region more accurately than other methods. For the video coding system, a region-based video codec based on H.263+ with the option mode of modified quantization is set up. We adjust the distortion weight parameter and variance at the macroblock layer to control the qualities at different regions. Experimental results show that the proposed method can significantly improve the quality at the ROI. Our method is suitable for real time videoconferencing.

articleTitle: An investigation of the coexistence of 802.11g WLAN and high data rate Bluetooth enabled consumer electronic devices in indoor home and office environments
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The anticipated proliferation of various wireless local area network (WLAN) enabled devices in the near future is likely to result in increased mutual interference in the 2.45 GHz industrial, scientific and medical (ISM) band. The paper investigates the impact of standard Bluetooth and high data rate (HDR) Bluetooth interference on IEEE 802.11g enabled consumer electronic devices and vice versa. Technical design issues for HDR Bluetooth and 802.11g systems implemented in software are presented. Packet error rate (PER) versus signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) plots are presented. The improvement in performance attained in 802.11g systems by using erasures in the corrupted subcarriers is briefly discussed.

articleTitle: Development and features of a TV navigation system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A new TV navigation system to support viewing TV programs was developed and subjective evaluation tests were carried out. It recommends optimum programs depending on viewing habit and viewers profile besides viewers' easy program selection.

articleTitle: An improved digital watermarking technique for protecting JPEG images
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A new semi-blind digital watermarking technique is proposed using the modified discrete cosine transformation (MDCT). The results show that the quality of the watermarked image is high and is robust to compression, noise, filtering and geometric transformations.

articleTitle: Printed circuit fractal antennas
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Fractal antennas is a new member in the family of antennas. They have peculiar properties that make them interesting candidates for applications where wideband, multiband, input impedance, SWR are important parameters of the overall performance. The use of printed circuit fractal antennas is proposed, investigated, simulated and measured as part of telecommunication systems that has seen a revival lately due to the wireless and mobile consumer applications. Although antennas have been used for long time, they have many limitations. The fractal antennas offer solutions to a number of these limitations and can be manufactured as useful planar shapes for consumer applications.

articleTitle: An implementation of configurable digital watermarking system in MPEG video encoder
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A new VLSI architecture of a real-time communication-based watermarking system for the spatial and transform domain is presented. The communication-based watermarking technique applied spread spectrum techniques and a perceptual visual model to build a watermarking system in which it is suitable for raw video sequence watermarking. The proposed architecture is adequate for specific function IP combining with a real-time video encoder.

articleTitle: A secure conditional access system using digital signature and encryption
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A new conditional access system architecture is proposed. It uses XML digital signature and encryption to securely distribute audio, video, image, and data on the Web. It also supports payment transactions in a secure environment.

articleTitle: Impulse burst position detection and channel estimation schemes for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Channel estimation schemes for OFDM systems in impulsive environments are investigated. Their performances are studied in the cases of static and mobile hilly terrain single frequency network channels. Additionally, results on a simple practical impulse burst position detection method are also presented.

articleTitle: Fast sub-pixel motion estimation having lower complexity
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents fast sub-pixel motion estimation having less computational complexity. The proposed methods are based on mathematical models of the motion compensated errors for moving picture compression. The methods need no interpolation from the integer-pixel search results. In order to decide the coefficients of the models, the motion compensated errors of the neighboring pixels around motion vectors are used. The errors were already obtained during the pixel accuracy full search. The models estimate the motion compensated errors at sub-pixel accuracy level. The proposed mathematical models are referred to as Model 1, Model 2, Model 3, modified Model 2, and modified Model 3, respectively. The simulation results show that the performance depends on the accuracy of the models. The performance of the proposed methods, having less computational complexity, is close to that of the full search method.

articleTitle: A fast logo insertion algorithm for MPEG compressed video
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose a fast logo insertion algorithm for MPEG compressed video. We employ compressed data domain logo insertion with an in-loop re-quantization process. We also adaptively use the MV (motion vector) and coding information of the input MPEG stream according to logo and non-logo regions. Experiments have shown that much faster and higher quality logo insertion is obtained compared with baseband domain insertion.

articleTitle: Multi-service models for interactive television
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents the integration of interactive television into a multi-service model, which is complemented by PC and mobile-based services and favoured by the European public broadcast industry. Application of the multi-service model into a scenario for a family holiday is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Hierarchical motion compensated frame rate up-conversion based on the Gaussian/Laplacian pyramid
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We present a hierarchical motion compensated frame rate conversion (HMC-FRC) algorithm based on the pyramid structure for high-quality video reconstruction. The conversion between images having different frame rates causes motion jitter and blurring near moving object boundaries. To reduce degradation in video quality, the proposed algorithm performs motion estimation (ME) and motion compensated frame rate up-conversion at each level of the Gaussian/Laplacian image pyramid. In experiments, the frame rate of the video sequence is up-converted by a factor of two. Experiments with several test sequences show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A temporal noise reduction filter based on image sensor full-frame data
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper describes a temporal filter aimed at the simultaneous cancellation of fixed pattern noise and temporal noise from image sequences by exploiting all the data provided by a typical image sensor (e.g. CCD/CMOS).

articleTitle: USB on-the-go interface for portable devices
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The need to connect portable electronic devices to each other has accelerated the adoption of USB on-the-go as an industry standard wired interface. This paper presents an overview of USB on-the-go, and explores some of the applications that this interface enables. Cell phones present a unique challenge to this interface, because of their need to also connect to an analog carkit. The way in which USB on-the-go was adapted to address this requirement is also described.

articleTitle: Home server for home digital service environments
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper proposes the basic concepts and functions of the home server platform for implementing a digital home. Our home server has various kinds of home network devices and multimedia processing modules. The digital TV (D-TV) service and remote multimedia service are available, and the instant message service is implemented on the basis of open service gateway initiative (OSGi) framework. It is certain that our home server can be a core device of the home digital service environments.

articleTitle: ACE: a software framework for autonomic appliances computing
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper presents a software framework for an autonomic home ubiquitous computing environment called ACE system. This system is designed and implemented to reduce the users' burden of operating networked appliances. The ACE system enables autonomic behavior of the home ubiquitous computing environment with its sensing, planning, and operating functionalities.

articleTitle: A car use FM broadcasting receiver using digital signal processing techniques
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We have developed a car use FM broadcasting receiver with improved reduction ability of noise due to the interference between adjacent channels and multi-path. This paper describes the system construction and digital signal processing.

articleTitle: Throughput enhancement for wireless communication systems using the multiple antenna technique MIMO
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: One of the main goals in developing the next generation wireless communication system is increasing the data rates. A promising way to achieve this is the combination of multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) signal processing with orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM). A test system has been built in which the OFDM based wireless LAN standard, IEEE 802.11a, is extended with MIMO. Initial measurements are performed in a typical office building and successful transmissions up to 162 Mb/s are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Joint encoding/decoding enhanced multi-streams vestigial side band transmission (E-VSB) for North-American single carrier HDTV terrestrial broadcast
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A new enhanced VSB (E-VSB) transmission system has been proposed to improve the North-American HDTV terrestrial broadcast. The system allows better reception for portable, mobile, and indoor receivers, by means of two backward compatible robust and scalable data stream, so-called 1/2 rate and 1/4 rate, that can co-exist with the normal stream. One originality of the system lies in the possibility for the receiver to enhance the normal transmission mode by combining the information provided by the two robust streams to improve cancellation of channel multipath. The improvement of the main service depends on the coding mechanism used for the enhanced streams and the number and the position of the enhanced symbols in the VSB frame. We illustrate the coding and the normal/enhanced packet multiplexing mechanisms that are used to achieve this goal.

articleTitle: An artificial neural network-based scheme for fragile watermarking
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper proposes an artificial neural network based fragile watermarking scheme. Our method can detect tampering, locate where the tampering has occurred and recognize what kind of alteration has occurred. The experimental results have proven that our method is indeed effective.

articleTitle: Apply phase information in RST image watermarking
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper presents a novel digital image watermarking scheme, based on the Fourier-Mellin transform, that is invariant to rotation, scaling, and translation (RST). We embed the watermark in the log-polar mappings of the Fourier magnitude spectrum of the original image and use the phase information of the original image to rectify the watermark positions. The scheme avoids computing inverse log-polar mapping (ILPM), and therefore preserves the image quality. Evaluations demonstrate that the scheme is invariant to rotation and translation, and sufficiently invariant to scaling transformation, and very robust to JPEG compression.

articleTitle: A new service delivery and provisioning architecture for home appliances
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a new service delivery and provisioning architecture for home appliances, the basic idea is to subtly incorporate the SIP architecture into the OSGi (Open Service Gateway Initiative) based service delivery and provisioning system. Thus the strengths of OSGI and SIP based Internet telephony system are unified so that wide range of services and devices can be supported. A prototype system is implemented to show the features of the system.

articleTitle: A hierarchical lossless/lossy coding system for high quality audio up to 192 kHz sampling 24 bit format
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We present a flexible audio coding system for use in the unbroken transmission of high-quality (192 kHz sampling rate, 24-bit digitization (max.)) stereo-audio data streams, either live or recorded. The system provides both lossless and variable-level lossy quality; quality is selectable to suit a full range of wide- and narrow-band IP networks. As input signals for transmission at the server PC, less than nine PCM sound files in different formals are simultaneously encodable, and the efficiency of simultaneous compression is very high. The system is realized by software that runs on a typical PC. This makes everyone able to transmit high-quality sound anywhere within the IP networks. An MPEG-4 audio codec (TwinVQ or AAC) provides the core of the lossy-coding module.

articleTitle: The new method of license key management for content distribution system $key management for grouping content
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The importance of copyright protection has increased with the rapid spread of content distribution services. In one means of copyright protection, contents are protected by encryption. In this method, license keys are essential and distributed to decrypt contents. The paper presents a new method of license key management that can manage contents as groups. It uses some group keys in addition to license keys for decrypting content. Each of the group keys can decrypt all contents belonging to each group. As an example of applying the proposed method, a cooking recipe distribution system is introduced.

articleTitle: Blu-ray disc - a versatile format for recording high definition video
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The Blu-ray Disc standard was announced in 2002 by a number of leading consumer electronics companies. This paper describes the application format, which is designed for recording digital TV signals including high definition TV. The standard was designed from the start for rewritable media, and includes support for high quality video editing.

articleTitle: Performance improvement techniques for CCK-OFDM WLAN modem
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose a new scheme using the 1st order Reed-Muller (RM) code with variables 4, RM(1, 4), which improves the performance of IEEE 802.11g wireless local area network (WLAN) modems in terms of peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) and symbol error probability (SER). We show the equivalence between the complementary code keying (CCK) codeword and the coset of the 1st order Reed-Muller code with variables 3, RM(1, 3). This proposed system shows better performance than CCK in terms of PAPR and SER. When the number of IFFT points is 64, we reduce PAPR by 9dB and get a coding gain of 3dB at symbol error probability of 10/sup -4/. Since the system of RM(1, 4) can be implemented using the RM(1, 3), there is a little increase in complexity.

articleTitle: Networked home appliance system using Bluetooth technology integrating appliance control/monitoring with Internet service
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We introduce a novel home network system for creating a new service architecture by connecting home appliances, networked using Bluetooth technology, with the Internet. We also show a method of controlling/monitoring networked home appliances with commands that are implicitly integrated within the service contents offered by an application service provider to a user. Finally, we discuss the advantages of this system.

articleTitle: Narrowband OFDM receiver architecture for partial reception of ISDB-T signal
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper describes the architecture of narrowband OFDM (orthogonal frequency division multiplexing) receiver for partial reception of the ISDB-T (integrated services digital broadcasting for terrestrial) standard. The receiver employs the direct conversion structure in order to mitigate the RF (radio frequency) and IF (intermediate frequency) filter requirements. A rectangular-shape BPF (band pass filter) required for removing the interference from the adjacent segments is implemented in the digital domain. The implementation loss of the proposed receiver is less than 1 dB against the theoretical bit error rate limit at a bit error rate of 10/sup -2/.

articleTitle: A passive-style buttonless mobile terminal
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: As a simple and intuitive interface, a new-style mobile terminal without a single operation button has been developed. The terminal contains an accelerometer and is operated by gestures, such as changing its inclination or by shaking it, replacing conventional button operation. The list of contents is presented as "bubbles flowing in the water" instead of the conventional hierarchical structure. Using such gesture commands allows the user to enjoyably browse contents such as text, video, still pictures, and music.

articleTitle: Recording interactive TV
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Digital TV is now being enhanced with interactivity based on such standards as multimedia home platform (MHP) (see DVB MHP Specification 1.1, tm2485, tam668r12) and digital TV application software environment (DASE). Recording digital TV with interactivity poses some problems when the interactivity is directly linked to the A/V content. We propose a method of recording interactive TV, taking MHP as an example, which separates the interactivity from the A/V content. The interactively is multiplexed in the broadcast in a DSM-CC (digital storage media command and control) object carousel (see ISO/IEC 13818-6). Taking the interactivity out of the transport stream (TS) (see ISO/IEC 13818-1) and storing it separately allows us to solve the problems related to recording interactive TV.

articleTitle: Time distributed DCT architecture for multimedia applications
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents the design of a new time distributed architecture (TDA), which outlines architecture submitted to MPEG4 Part9 committee ISO/IEC JTC1/SC29/WG11 MPEG2002/M8565. The proposed TDA optimizes the 2D-DCT performance. It uses a time distribution mechanism to exploit the computational redundancy within the inner product computation module. It schedules the computation to meet the application specific requirements of input, output and coefficients word length. The Coefficient matrix uses linear mappings to assign necessary computation to processor elements in the space and the time domains. The performance analysis shows a performance savings in excess of 71% as compared to the current optimized general and application specific architectures for DCT is achieved.

articleTitle: Next generation DSL: single-chip ADSL+ and LDSL for home networks
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: In spite of the current downturn in the telecommunications sector, DSL has become arguably the most promising broadband delivery mechanism in the world. It is fueling an explosion of consumer electronics applications worldwide that demand a high rate of data transfer. By far the most popular form of consumer DSL is ADSL (asymmetric digital subscriber lines). ADSL can be realized with highly integrated silicon implementations. In this paper, we describe a single-chip ADSL customer premises modem/router that is capable of delivering 18+ Mbit/s of data to the home network.

articleTitle: Home appliance control system over Bluetooth with a cellular phone
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose a home appliance control system over Bluetooth/spl trade/ with a cellular phone, which enables remote-control, fault-diagnosis and software-update for home appliances through Java/spl reg/ applications on a cellular phone.

articleTitle: System-on-chip platform for high-speed DVD+R/RW video and data applications
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper discusses the architecture of a highly-integrated subsystem for optical disc engines that operate with write-once (CD-R, DVD+R) and erasable (CD-RW DVD+RW) media. Cost-efficient, high-performance optical disc players and recorders for audio/video and computer applications can be built by using only a few additional integrated circuits (ICs). The described system-on-chip (SoC) has been designed to write DVD+R/RW discs at overspeeds up to 8X and read DVDs at maximum 16X. The operation in the so-called super combo mode is also possible, for which the SoC has been prepared to record compact discs at overspeeds as high as 48X and play them back at 56X.

articleTitle: Development of media and recording technologies for 4/spl times/-speed DVD-R
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We had been developing new medium and recording technology of DVD-R, DVD Recordable (write-once DVD) for 4/spl times/-speed recording. The essential technologies to realize the 4/spl times/-speed DVD-R we confirmed are described in this paper.

articleTitle: Measurement of indoor antennas using GTEM cell
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Characterization of indoor antennas has become a current issue, especially with DTV. The GTEM (Gigahertz TEM) cell, originally made to test equipment for EMI susceptibility, is often available to CE designers. The device is also suited for measurement of relatively small indoor television antennas including those with integrated amplifiers.

articleTitle: Protected data storage system for optical discs
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a system that provides a data storage area on optical discs which is protected against unauthorized access. The protected area is referred to as a key locker. It is of particular importance to applications that use digital rights management (DRM). An advantage of the key locker concept is its DRM-agnostic nature. As such, any DRM system can benefit from the protected area.

articleTitle: Optimal frame memory and data transfer scheme for MPEG-4 shape coding
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: An optimal frame memory and data transfer scheme is proposed for MPEG-4 shape coding in embedded systems. Based on the inherent property of shape information, the binary alpha blocks are losslessly compressed with a fixed 50% compression ratio and can be randomly accessed. Therefore the size of frame memory can be reduced to 50% with a small index table (2.73% to 5.08% of the original frame memory size), and the number of memory references can be reduced to 56.25%. The data transfer scheme combines the run length coding and addressing mode to reduce data transfer time to 9.39%.

articleTitle: A new digital TV interface employing speech recognition
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper introduces a new interface system for digital TV control utilizing speech recognition. The system, equipped with a remote control with a built-in microphone, employs speaker adaptation techniques and methods for assisting the user.

articleTitle: ESTER: experiencing smell through electronic reality
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The aim of our paper is to give the consumers of the virtual world a truly virtual experience by adding one more dimension - the sense of smell. We have accomplished this by means of a special electromechanical device specifically designed by us for this purpose. According to the type of application the ESTER is associated with, it will dispense the scent required by the application at the right time.

articleTitle: Consumer networking infrastructure based on IEEE 1394b
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a consumer networking infrastructure for all digital data transport within a home. IEEE 1394b provides a unified high performance serial bus for communication, multimedia, and home automation use. Other in-house or external communication technologies can be connected via gateways.

articleTitle: Efficient real-time implementation of MPEG-4 audiovisual decoder using DSP and RISC chips
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a real-time embedded implementation of MPEG-4 visual simple profile and advanced audio coding (AAC) decoder using DSP and RISC chips. We optimize MPEG-4 modules using the seamless double buffering memory structure, the dual MAC applied for half pixel motion compensation (MC), and fast floating-to-integer conversion algorithm in AAC.

articleTitle: Optimum selection algorithm of motion estimation blocks for fast and robust digital image stabilization
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose new optimum selection algorithm of motion estimation blocks to improve accuracy and computational cost. In our algorithm, motion vectors are segmented robustly to some regions which support each motion model. The experimental results show that it achieved the high accurate of motion estimation, and the computing time was shortening up to approximately 1/20 compared with the conventional hierarchical full-search method. It is confirmed that our algorithm has enough robustness under ill-conditioned scenes.

articleTitle: An embedded camera lens distortion correction method for mobile computing applications
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper describes a lens distortion correction method suitable for low cost digital cameras. Lens distortion coefficient is estimated via simplified camera calibration, after which image warping with inverse spatial mapping adapted for a DSP architecture is applied. Experimental results show that image quality after distortion correction provides comparable performance as when a quality lens system of distortion less than 2% is adopted.

articleTitle: Network architecture for home energy management system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper describes a network architecture for a home energy management system. A robust power line communication modem with dispersed tones, a compact control interface for networked appliances, and a network adapter that connects an appliance to the home network were developed.

articleTitle: An audio watermarking algorithm based on significant component modulation
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Digital watermarking which hides the binary information in the digital multimedia files is an effective method for copyright protection. We propose a new algorithm that hides the binary information in perceptually significant tonal components and non-tonal components. The quantization index modulation (QIM) algorithm is applied to embed the watermark in these perceptually significant components. The experimental results show that the proposed watermarking algorithm gives a high recovery rate after the attack by commonly used audio data manipulations, such as digital-analog conversion, low-pass filtering, and lossy audio compression.

articleTitle: Towards a high definition experience using a high-quality 3D video format convertor
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The demand for high definition displays is increasing, while the availability of high resolution sources is still very limited. This opens the opportunity to combine high quality scan rate conversion with spatial up-conversion and enhancement to obtain a high definition experience from standard definition video. We present a 3-dimensional (3D) scan-convertor using motion-compensation and sharpness enhancement technology to provide a HD experience from SD sources.

articleTitle: A reliable power line carrier and wireless data concentrator for broadband energy information network
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper presents a hybrid data concentrator for Internet access control of a broadband energy information network system (ENIS). The transmission media between the data concentrator and its associated home energy controllers (HEC) are based on either a power line carrier (PLC) or a low power wireless channel for improved reliability. To install such a system, we propose a channel reliability estimation method for selecting the appropriate transmission channel. Furthermore, the overall system has been tested to justify its validity and reliability, and the specifications of the PLC and RF modules, as well as the embedded system are briefly illustrated.

articleTitle: Comparison of equalisation strategies for multi-carrier CDMA
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper focuses on the bit error rate (BER) performance of equalisation strategies for a downlink MC-CDMA based system. Simulation results utilising maximal ratio combining (MRC), orthogonal restoring combining (ORC), equal gain combining (EGC) and minimum mean square error combining (MMSEC) for a multiuser scenario are presented. In addition, we analyse the relative complexities of each scheme and discuss their suitability for implementation in future consumer products.

articleTitle: Agent-based appliance integration and user interface extension reflecting environmental and personal properties
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose a framework of user-oriented appliance integration for improved usability of networked appliances. A newly-composed function appears as a functional extension of existing appliances via a personal interface, which maintains an adaptive user interface.

articleTitle: RMP (rights management and protection) system for digital broadcasting based on home servers
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents an RMP (rights management and protection) system for digital broadcasting based on home servers using receivers with home storage devices. This RMP system is suitable for broadcasting, enabling rights protection and advanced access control (term of validity, usage and charge condition, etc.) of stored content on home storage devices.

articleTitle: A single-chip hybrid media processor for CRT and matrix displays-based televisions
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The new generation of CRT or matrix displays-based television requires high quality video, audio and graphics processing at a lower cost. When available, such a media processing system will drive the wide spread usage of high performance television. A single chip hybrid (analog/digital) TV media processor is designed to implement high quality television at a lower cost.

articleTitle: A scalar coprocessor for accelerating the G723.1 and G729A speech coders
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A scalar accelerator that reduces significantly the complexity of the ITU-T G723.1 and G729A speech coders is described. Preliminary architecture space exploration indicates up to 49% reduction in the total number of instructions executed through the introduction of a few custom instructions and small changes to the reference C source code. The accelerator is designed as an autonomous unit that can be attached to a configurable RISC CPU where it makes use of the host register file and load/store pipeline.

articleTitle: Streamed wireless video for low-end consumer digital cameras
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The latest models of low-end consumer digital cameras have begun to support A/V streaming directly to the memory card. This greatly enhances the utility of the camera to an end user. We investigate techniques to provide a similar streaming service from camera directly to a wireless network server.

articleTitle: Effects of "limit equalizer" in Blu-ray disk format
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A "limit equalizer" which we have developed was adopted in the Blu-ray disk format. We investigate a behavior of every data patterns of (1,7) runlength-limited (RLL) code using the limit equalizer by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Complexity-adaptive streaming architecture for video multicasting to CE devices
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper presents a layered streaming architecture for multicasting of scalable video to devices connected at various bandwidths and having different complexity-levels. The approach combines layered coding with a novel multi-channel streaming system that enables receiver-driven adaptation based on the experienced network conditions and device complexity.

articleTitle: Design of a baseband modem for IEEE 802.11g wireless LAN systems
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper presents the design and performance of a baseband modem for wireless LAN systems. The modem fully complies with the IEEE 802.11g standard draft 4.0. It is capable of operating in any of available modes such as ERP-DSSS/CCK, ERP-OFDM, Extended Rate PBCC, and CCK-OFDM. It offers different data rates from 1 Mbps to 54 Mbps and handles DBPSK, DQPSK, QPSK, 8-PSK, BPSK, 16-QAM, and 64-QAM modulation schemes. We show the BER performance of the presented modem as the result of simulation under AWGN and multipath channels.

articleTitle: CORBA based core middleware architecture supporting seamless interoperability between standard home network middlewares
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a CORBA based core middleware architecture for supporting seamless interoperability, between standard home network middlewares. To support CORBA on an IEEE 1394-based home network, we design and implement a CORBA programming platform without loss of real-time properties of the IEEE 1394 protocol. To customize the real-time CORBA properties on the IEEE 1394 protocol, firstly, we develop a specially designed device driver of IEEE 1394 adaptor under the RT-Linux kernel. On the top of the device driver, we design and implement an IEEE 1394 ORB for supporting CORBA. The proposed ORB consists of two components. One is the IEEE 1394 asynchronous ORB according to the GIOP specification of CORBA to support the interoperability, with other ORB such as IIOP, the other is the IEEE 1394 isochronous ORB to keep the real-time properties of the IEEE 1394 protocols. The implemented CORBA platform is verified by testing its performance with a practical home network model.

articleTitle: Implementation of digital watermarking system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: It is easy to make perfect unauthorised copies on a large scale in the music, film, book and software publishing industries. A digital watermark - a hidden copyright message with hidden serial numbers-can be used as a direct method of preventing unauthorised copying. This paper presents a novel digital watermarking system based on vector quantisation (VQ) and discrete cosine transform (DCT), which can embed a grey level image. The proposed new system can embed 16 times more information than other traditional DCT based watermarking system. The recovered images have high peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) value and good visual quality. This system is robust in terms of both JPEG compression and other signal processing attacks.

articleTitle: A burst error concealment technique for visual communications in a mobile environment
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A burst error concealment technique is proposed for visual communications in a mobile environment. The proposed method is applicable to wireless visual communications due to its low computational cost and acceptable image quality. In the transmission of real-time video over wireless, due to the limited bandwidth available, a frame is divided into just 2 or 3 packets. Therefore, the loss of a packet introduces burst errors which are the loss of the several rows of macroblocks (MBs) in the frame. The proposed error concealment technique estimates the lost motion vector (MV) by using the neighboring MVs of the damaged MB.

articleTitle: High-quality speech acquisition and recognition system for home-agent robot
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A PC-based real-time speech processing system designed for the home-agent robot is presented. The key feature of the proposed system is the speech acquisition module using a microphone array which enables acquiring high-quality speech of a distant talker.

articleTitle: A channel characterization technique using frequency-domain pilot time-domain correlation method for DVB-T systems
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A new channel characterization technique using a frequency-domain pilot time-domain correlation (FPTC) method is proposed for DVB-T systems. This new technique is based on the time-domain correlation between the received signal and the pilot sequence embedded in the DVB-T signal, which is derived from the frequency domain pilots and known to the channel characterization equipment. Compared with other channel estimation techniques, the major advantage of this proposal is its simple implementation. Channel impulse response can be estimated without timing recovery. The impact of the non-perfect carrier recovery is very small since the correlation is only computed on a short period of the received signal. The proposed method has been verified through numerical simulations and field tests. The possible improvement of the estimation accuracy is indicated.

articleTitle: Uneven luminance and image defect improvement on driver circuit in LEDs array flat display system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper intends to improve the uneven luminance and image defect phenomena due to the higher scan rate in the LEDs array flat display system. A flexible digital controller is proposed to overcome the following two issues. One is the improvement of image defect by using interlaced scan under the high frequency scan rate for the power transistors in the driver circuit. The other is the voltage compensation for the uneven luminance due to the loading effect in the driver circuit. An image defect followed by the increasing scan rate is a critical problem which is an obstruction for the next generation display development.

articleTitle: Real-time video indexing and non-linear video browsing for digital TV receivers with persistent storage
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: As one of the first results of video indexing research, applied to real-world consumer products, we present genre-independent video browsing functions for digital TV receivers with persistent storage, i.e. PVRs. The presented browsing functionalities are enabled by real-time video indexing technology, which can handle HD-class MPEG-2 broadcast video in real-time.

articleTitle: QoS guaranteed MPEG-4 based live transmission system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a QoS guaranteed MPEG-4 based live audio/video transmission system over broadband networks. By applying bandwidth adaptive rate control and error adaptive concealment methods, picture quality has been greatly improved under unstable network bandwidths with instantaneous packet loss.

articleTitle: A novel residual carrier synchronization technique for M-QAM-OFDM in the presence of intercarrier interference
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose a new carrier phase synchronization algorithm which can recover residual frequency offset as well as phase offset by using proposed QD (quadrant decision) method. The salient feature of this method is that residual carrier frequency offset can be compensated by using an FFT demodulated signal without the aid of GI (guard interval) or pilots.

articleTitle: Motion adaptive search for fast motion estimation
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper presents motion adaptive search (MAS), that effectively utilizes motion activity information to achieve superior performance both in terms of quality and speed in comparison with other fast search algorithms for motion estimation. The main features of MAS are: the early elimination of search by detecting the stationary macroblocks; the adaptation of both the search window size and the search strategy based on motion activity information; the minimization of overlap of search points by performing intelligent search.

articleTitle: Adaptive trace deletion method
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: An adaptive trace deletion method for the management of survivor paths in Viterbi decoders is proposed. The proposed scheme has an adaptive decoding length. By using the proposed scheme, lower latency and lower power consumption than the traditional trace deletion scheme can be achieved.

articleTitle: Universal home network middleware (UHNM) guaranteeing seamless interoperability among the heterogeneous home network middleware for future home networks
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents the UHNM architecture, which guarantees seamless interoperability among the heterogeneous home network middleware for future home. The UHNM provides the high-level abstraction and zero-configuration, and makes new services without great effort.

articleTitle: Extension of the multimedia home platform for applications in an automotive environment
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: With the goal to create a single open standard software platform and, therefore, to enable a horizontal market for iTV services, the DVB Project developed the MHP (Multimedia Home Platform). The MHP has been adopted world-wide by many countries and by operators of various networks as the standard platform. Several groups started to investigate the potential of an MHP based platform in a mobile environment. We are active members of some of these groups working on new concepts and APIs to design a mobile MHP version. This paper describes some of our ideas covering issues like the mobile reception of MHP applications or specific control mechanisms (e.g. speech control, adaptability to various input devices).

articleTitle: A one-pass variable bit-rate video coding for storage media
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a one-pass VBR coding algorithm, which provides high visual quality and satisfies a target bit-budget constraint. Since the proposed algorithm exploits the remaining bit amount instead of average bit-rate in determining quantization scale, it can balance the target bit-budget. The proposed algorithm also achieves real-time VBR video encoding requiring high visual quality for storage media.

articleTitle: Managing multimedia data services with multiple ensemble decoding architecture in digital audio broadcasting system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper proposes the architecture of multiple ensemble service in DAB network, in which they can transmit and receive more than one ensemble through multiple transmitters, which covers the same service area. Using this architecture, ensemble providers and transmission network providers can have more flexible management environment of DAB networks as well as they can accommodate more than 1.5 Mbps data limit of one ensemble.

articleTitle: Error concealment algorithm using interested direction for JPEG 2000 image transmission
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The newly defined JPEG 2000 delivers scalable and region-of-interest images with lower bit rates in Internet and wireless communications. However, any data loss in the JPEG 2000 bitstream affects the consequent bitplanes and even possibly destroys the whole picture. We propose a new algorithm to recover the damaged bitplane data according to the interested directional pattern in the subband. Simulation results show that the proposed concealment algorithm can achieve much smoother edges on the reconstructed image.

articleTitle: A SOC for multimedia network devices
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Two main aspects of multimedia SoC are addressed in this paper. First, a multiprocessor system employing reconfigurable hardware blocks with coarse and fine grain structures is introduced. It alleviates the tradeoff between computing performance and circuit flexibility for a wide range of applications. Second, a clock generator for synchronous audio and video interfaces is presented. In order to provide high portability and compatibility with the digital design flow it consists of digital standard cells only. Integrated on a 0.25 /spl mu/m CMOS process, the system occupies 25 mm/sup 2/ and operates at 100 MHz. Computation speedup of up to factor 9.7 over stand-alone CPU solutions could be achieved. The clock generator runs at 200 MHz and provides a frequency resolution of 0.06 ppm with an expected output jitter of less than 30 ps; RMS.

articleTitle: Optimal MPEG-2 transcoding for DVD recording system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper describes the application of transcoding techniques for high quality DVD recording. The architecture of a DVD recording system is presented, along with an optimal algorithm to perform quantization scale selection and mode decision in the transcoder. The experimental results show that the proposed optimal transcoding scheme outperforms the cascaded transcoder and MPEG-2 TM5 encoder.

articleTitle: QoP-driven scheduling for MPEG video decoding
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Dropped or incorrectly decoded frames degrade a video's quality of presentation (QoP), which can be conveniently measured by the number of correctly decoded frames. We demonstrate that the frame completion ratio (CR) does not represent well the QoP of an MPEG video. We then propose a new QoP metric and a set of online scheduling algorithms that achieve better QoP, particularly for overloaded systems.

articleTitle: Spatial-temporal motion estimation for image reconstruction and mouse functionality with optical or capacitive sensors
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper describes an innovative solution to perform mouse functionality ("navigation') and image reconstruction ("scanning'). The application uses a predictive block-matching motion estimation algorithm and an optical or capacitive sensor. Results show this solution provides integrated mouse and scanner functionality at a very low cost.

articleTitle: Design of a low-cost VLSI architecture for 1.6 kbps speech synthesis
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We present a low-cost architecture for speech synthesis at 1.6 kbps. The speech synthesis algorithm is formulated in terms of a hardware-oriented design. Based on our proposed speech vocoder, the novel architecture consumes lower hardware resources and is therefore suited for hardware implementation.

articleTitle: A secure card solution for remote access for mobile workforce
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We developed a secure remote access system using a secure flash card with security functions. The flash card has a tamper resistant module that stores users' authentication information and security keys. The proposed secure remote access system offers users features such as improved usability and security of stored information.

articleTitle: A newly proposed ATSC DTV system for transmitting a robust bit-stream along with the standard bit-stream
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper describes the proposed improvements to the ATSC DTV standard. The proposal provides a mechanism for embedding a new robust bit-stream in the standard bitstream in a backward compatible manner. The robust stream has a higher threshold of visibility (TOV) compared to the standard stream and can be transmitted either in the pseudo 2-VSB mode or in the E-VSB mode. A prototype transceiver system, based on the proposed system, has been developed and is being tested in the field.

articleTitle: A CMOS image sensor (CIS) with low power motion detection for security camera applications
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a low power motion detection algorithm and system architecture. The proposed architecture uses just one bit data of each selected pixel for motion detection, where less than a few percentages of the total pixels will be used. Since only a small amount of image data is used for the motion detection, extremely low power consumption is possible. This architecture is useful for portable battery-operated security cameras.

articleTitle: Requirements and referential software architecture for home server-based inter-home multimedia collaboration services
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents requirements and referential software architecture for home server-based multimedia collaboration services. This architecture can be applied to home servers or mobile devices for collaborative works like voice over Internet protocol, collaborative Web-browsing, file transmission, and instant messaging.

articleTitle: System on a chip with 4 Mb built-in flash ROM for CD-RW drives capable of 52/spl times/ CD-R and 32/spl times/ CD-RW write speed
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We proposed a system on a chip (SOC) for CD-RW (ReWritable) drives. This SOC consists of 32 bit RISC CPU, 4 Mb flash ROM, C1/C2 ENDEC, data recovery, digital servo, C3 ENDEC, ATAPI and write strategy blocks. It supports up to 52X CD-R and 32X CD-RW recording speed. Most of the servo functions except the loop filter are implemented in software with embedded CPU. the servo loop filter is implemented in a hardwire 32 bit adder and a 16/spl times/16 multiplier. We designed a new data slicing circuit to improve readability. Also, we introduced a new linking method to link data seamlessly even in the occurrence of buffer under-run. This chip was fabricated in 0.18 /spl mu/m, 1-poly 5-metal CMOS process and occupies an active area of 5.2 mm /spl times/ 5.6 mm.

articleTitle: E-VSB map signaling
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Addition of a backwards-compatible enhanced data mode (E-VSB) to the ATSC (Advanced Television Systems Committee) standard 8-VSB transmissions requires a way to reliably indicate to new enhanced receivers the mix of E-VSB and 8-VSB data. This mix is indicated by "map" data using bits in the reserved area of the 8-VSB data field sync. This must be done in a manner that allows for changing the mix "on the fly" without loss of E-VSB/8-VSB data. The reception of the map data must be significantly more robust than the lowest code rate E-VSB data. A method is described that offers reliable signaling without latency for channel-change in the receiver.

articleTitle: Neyman-Pearson test for DC restoration error correction
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a novel DC restoration error correction method based on the statistical hypothesis testing. The proposed method can remove the line-wise error in analog images introduced during the DC restoration processes.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of hybrid ARQ schemes for the application of multimedia mobile devices
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We present a performance analysis of hybrid ARQ (automatic repeat request) protocols using Reed-Solomon code for various traffic types, and highlight relations between the characteristics of various Internet traffics and hybrid ARQ schemes.

articleTitle: DTV lip-sync test using time indexed audio and video signals without effect on program
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The paper concentrates on a lip-sync test for DTV with respect to audio and video signals using the digital bitstream. We propose a new lip-sync test method which does not affect the current program by use of the TATS (transient effect area test signals) and an additional sub-channel audio signal. The experimental result shows that the time difference between the audio and video signals can be easily measured by a captured oscilloscope waveform at any time.

articleTitle: Attack characterisation of compressed images
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose the use of robust watermarks to enable the characterisation of attacks even after lossy compression, such as JPEG and JPEG2000. A previously constructed Bayesian framework is used to allow characterisation of attacks from a predetermined library, and the double watermarking technique as earlier proposed by the authors is employed to generate the features used to drive the classifier. The results show that the developed techniques perform well for both types of compression.

articleTitle: A spatio-temporal equalization scheme for wireless Internet access in rural areas
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: Wireless local loop (WLL) is primarily used for providing multimedia services to subscribers in rural areas, particularly for locations where no existing comprehensive telephone networks are available. It provides an economical means of serving these areas with moderate data capacity. The availability of a radio link for data transfer between the subscriber and its corresponding base station is affected by effects such as multipath and rain attenuation. We evaluate the effectiveness of a spatial and temporal equalization scheme to combat the impacts of signal degradation.

articleTitle: Development of network digital camera and its performance evaluation
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper first describes the architecture of the network digital camera. Then, a real-time streaming system using the network digital camera, an access point (AP) and a digital photo album is proposed and evaluated. The evaluation is based on the characteristics of the packet transmission time, which depends on two varying parameters, namely, the condition and population of the wireless environment.

articleTitle: Secure and efficient MPEG delivery in wireless residential networks
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: To service multimedia data over wireless residential network, we solve the weak points of wireless LAN technology such as low bandwidth and high eavesdropping possibility. This paper presents a multimedia delivery system for the wireless residential network structure based on a new MPEG processing mechanism.

articleTitle: Contents protection system using smart card interface for digital CATV network based on the OpenCable specification
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: In this paper, we have proposed the merging of the OpenCable reference model with the smart card interface defined by ISO/IEC 7816-3 and have implemented a new conditional access system (CAS) using this interface along with a Personal Computer Memory Card International Association (PCMCIA) interface. In addition, we have also designed the hardware architecture of the point-of-deployment (POD) security module, designed with the Verilog HDL, using the above two interfaces. The designed POD security module has an embedded 32-bit reduced instruction set computer (RISC) microprocessor that manages applications, such as an MPEG-2 filter, descrambler, and Data Encryption Standard (DES).

articleTitle: A new approach for rustle noise canceling in pen-type voice recorder
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose a new algorithm to reject the rustle noise in a pen-type voice recorder. In the proposed method, we estimate the subspace on each subband, and design the optimal filter.

articleTitle: Compression-compatible robust watermarking based on guided scrambling for digital camera
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The author has applied a guided scrambling (GS) technique, usually used for a recording channel, to digital watermarking (Kunisa, A., Proc. SPIE: Security and Watermarking of Multimedia Contents, V, 2003). The paper modifies the GS-based watermarking algorithm to a block-wise watermarking system. It is well suited for compression processing, such as JPEG or JPEG2000, and is readily applied to digital cameras.

articleTitle: A novel track jump controller with hybrid track position detector for the optical disk drives
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a novel hybrid track position detector for the track jump control in optical disk drives. The proposed controller draws the feedback information from the HTP position information instead of the conventional track crossing velocity. The controller design is then based on the position information. The design leads to more accurate feedback information, and thus more accurate velocity profile. The experimental results show that the proposed controller achieves better seeks time performance. The short jump experiments also show that the proposed system can more effectively cancel the disk eccentricity effect.

articleTitle: Synchronized multimedia language on mobile phone
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper describes a synchronized multimedia language optimized for mobile phones. We can integrate sound, text, and images into a synchronized multimedia content by the language, and play it on mobile phones.

articleTitle: A CMOS 16-bit 20MSPS analog front end for scanner/MFP applications
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper presents a monolithic 16-bit analog front end (AFE) chip for CCD/CIS scanner and MFP(Multi-function Peripheral) systems incorporating a 16-bit analog-to-digital converter (ADC), a 3-channel high resolution correlated double sampler (CDS), a programmable gain amplifier (PGA) and an on-chip voltage reference. The AFE, fabricated in a 0.35 /spl mu/m CMOS process, occupies an active area of 8 mm/sup 2/ and consumes 300 mW at a 3 V supply. For the full signal path (CDS-PGA-ADC), no missing code is guaranteed at a 16-bit resolution and typical differential nonlinearity (DNL) and integral nonlinearity (INL) are +1.31-0.92 LSB and +6.7/-16.6 LSB, respectively.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of adaptive equalizer design for CCK-OFDM wireless LAN
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: An adaptive equalizer scheme is presented in the CCK-OFDM system for an IEEE 802.11g wireless LAN. The conventional OFDM system employs a guard interval and 1-tap frequency-domain equalizer (FEQ) to prevent delay spread distortion. When the channel impulse response (CIR) is larger than the guard intervals, the system performance is restricted by ISI and ICI. The proposed equalizer scheme consists of an adaptive time-domain equalizer (TEQ) using single carrier training data and a 1-tap FEQ using long training OFDM symbols. Its performance is better than the conventional OFDM system under severe delay spread and noise power conditions, especially in the case of CIR larger than guard intervals. This enables a reduction in the size of the guard interval, and thus the transmission efficiency of the OFDM system can be improved.

articleTitle: The addressing method of the Blu-ray disc system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The addressing of the blank Blu-ray disc is reported. The address information is recorded as the radial wobble with minimum shift keying + saw tooth. A decoding scheme is also described.

articleTitle: Weighted-adaptive motion-compensated frame rate up-conversion
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose a frame rate up-conversion algorithm using the weighted-adaptive motion-compensated interpolation (WAMCI) that reduces the blocking artifacts due to block-based processing. The proposed method is based on the interpolation scheme by weighted sum of multiple interpolation filtering results. Also, the blocking artifacts on the block boundaries are reduced by applying a technique similar to the overlapping-block motion compensation (OBMC) in the proposed method. To reduce the drawback of overlapping processing, the proposed method uses the motion analysis to determine the type of motion and applies the WAMCI adaptively. Experimental results indicate good performance of the proposed scheme with significantly reduced blocking artifacts.

articleTitle: A real time recording system for a camcorder by DVD video format
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A real time recording system, corresponding to recording on a DVD-R disc, has been newly developed for the DVD camcorder, where a unique area-dividing technology for the unrecorded area and a buffering technology are used. A large number of recording times was achieved using a title management system.

articleTitle: Development of plasma display panel using Ag fence electrode structure without ITO
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We developed a PDP using Ag fence electrode structure without ITO by a photo-printable thick film process. Optical optimization in electrodes dimension enabled similar performance to the conventional panel, with significant reduction in cost.

articleTitle: Robust 3D wavelet video watermarking
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach for digital watermarking and secure copyright protection of video, the principal aim being to discourage illicit copying and distribution of copyrighted material. The watermark is a copyright information encoded in the form of a spread spectrum signal to ensure the system security and is embedded in the three dimensional discrete wavelet transform (3D DWT) magnitude of video chunks. The performance of the presented technique is evaluated experimentally.

articleTitle: EIA-708-B closed captioning implementation
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The FCC-mandated implementation of the EIA-708-B standard for digital closed captioning by July 1, 2002. This paper reviews some important digital closed captioning implementation issues and recommendations addressed in CEB-10-A, "EIA- 708-B Implementation Guidance".

articleTitle: A multigroup STC system
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: An integrated MPEG2 system time clock unit able to recover and track the time base of up to four MPEG2 transport streams is presented. The described architecture allows generation of a time base for a dual/quad MPEG video/audio decoder system. The ability to receive 27 MHz clock from various sources and recover and track the encoder clock by using hardware/software methods results in greater flexibility and reduction of hardware cost. The proposed algorithm of a digital control system for 27 MHz clock recovery is shown to have a good performance and low computational complexity.

articleTitle: Motion vector correction based on the pattern-like image analysis
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: We propose a motion vector correction algorithm to correct the erroneous motion vectors due to the failures of conventional motion estimation (ME) based on block matching algorithms (BMA). The proposed method is based on the pattern-like image analysis that corrects the erroneous motion vectors by considering multiple possible motion vectors and by excluding the wrong motion vectors. Also, it does not significantly increase computational complexity since it uses the estimated motion vectors and the sum of absolute difference (SAD) previously obtained from the conventional ME. Experimental results indicate good performance of the proposed scheme combined with frame rate up-conversion system.

articleTitle: Development and application of a shadowmaskless tracking CRT and its chip set
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: The tracking tube we describe is a new color CRT concept without a shadow mask. Color reproduction is based on tracking: beam landing positions are measured and corrected in a feedback loop configuration. The paper deals with development and application aspects of the tracking tube and its chip set.

articleTitle: A low-power single-chip DTV terrestrial and cable transceiver IC
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A low-power single-chip IC is presented for a DTV terrestrial and cable transceiver. The IC can be configured in ATSC (8-VSB) or cable (J.83B 64/256 QAM) plug-and-play modes. The IC also integrates an out-of-band QPSK forward data channel and QPSK/QAM reverse data channel modulator.

articleTitle: An adaptive carrier synchronizer for M-QAM cable receiver
publicationTitle: 2003 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2003. ICCE.
abstract: A phase-locked loop is commonly used for carrier synchronization in a communication receiver. A carrier synchronizer with an adaptive loop bandwidth for rapid carrier frequency offset acquisition and low steady-state jitter is proposed. The new carrier recovery loop consists of a tracking-status detector and a loop bandwidth controller. The tracking-status detector monitors the frequency-estimate signal output from the loop filter, determining whether the residual carrier frequency offset is locked or not.
